defect_location.notes: CVE-2016-2176: X509_NAME_oneline 处理 crafted EBCDIC ASN.1 数据时 buffer over-read（CVE 描述: obtain sensitive information from process stack memory or cause a denial of service (buffer over-read)）。

source.simplification: 剥离 EBCDIC 转换层，保留『高位字节触发转义分支时向前多读一字节且不检查边界』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: 名字串最后一个字节是高位字节（crafted EBCDIC 数据），转义分支读 name[len]
